chrome_hint: eBay AU sold (Terapeak): 'Mickey Mouse watch expanding band vintage' and 'Bradley OR Lorus OR Timex Mickey Mouse mechanical watch'; 'Ray-Ban Wayfarer B&L marble OR 'Ray-Ban Wayfarer Bausch Lomb USA grey marble' (the marble Wayfarer II/Bausch & Lomb era can be worth well over $100); 'Disney child watch blue strap Bradley'; 'cultured pearl strand silver clasp lot'. Also Noble Numismatics watch archive for Mickey Mouse.
viewing_check: Sunglasses: read temple arm text and lens etching (Ray-Ban, Bausch & Lomb, USA, B&L or Made in Italy, W0xxx code) to settle genuine vs copy and era. Mickey watch: dial and caseback for maker (Bradley, Lorus, Timex, Ingersoll). Pearls: clasp stamps (925, 9ct), test a strand against a tooth for gritty cultured vs smooth glass, check knots and size.
